name: Chat metadata
content:
"""
title: Chat metadata
author: nemo
description: Inject the date, the clock, the timezone, the place and the language at the top of the chat. No key.
required_open_webui_version: 0.10.0
version: 1.0.4
licence: nemoe7 Noncommercial License 1.0.0
"""

# fmt: off

import os
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# The marker of the block. The filter replaces its own block, so a repeat does not stack them.
MARK = "[chat metadata]"


def _language(__request__: Any, configured: str) -> str:
  """The configured language, or the first value of `Accept-Language`."""
  headers = getattr(__request__, "headers", None)
  header = headers.get("accept-language") if headers is not None else None
  first = str(header or "").partition(",")[0].partition(";")[0].strip()
  return configured or first


class Filter:
  """1 system message at the top of the chat, drawn again on each turn so the clock stays fresh."""

  class Valves(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = Field(default=True, description="Draw the block.")
    location: str = Field(
      default="",
      description="The place, for example `Antipolo, Calabarzon, Philippines`. Empty draws no place line.",
    )
    location_approximate: bool = Field(
      default=False,
      description="Read the place as an IP lookup, so the label says `Approximate location`.",
    )
    language: str = Field(
      default="",
      description="The language, for example `en-PH`. Empty reads the request header.",
    )

  def __init__(self) -> None:
    self.valves = self.Valves()

  def _block(self, __request__: Any) -> str:
    """The lines of the block, from the clock of the server and the Valves."""
    now = datetime.now().astimezone().replace(microsecond=0)
    zone = now.tzname() or os.environ.get("TZ") or ""
    lines = [MARK, f"Current date/time: {now.isoformat()}"]
    if zone:
      lines.append(f"Timezone: {zone}")
    place = str(getattr(self.valves, "location", "") or "").strip()
    if place:
      label = "Approximate location" if self.valves.location_approximate else "Location"
      lines.append(f"{label}: {place}")
    language = str(getattr(self.valves, "language", "") or "").strip()
    lines.append(f"Language: {_language(__request__, language) or 'unknown'}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

  async def inlet(
    self, body: dict[str, Any], __request__: Any = None
  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Put the block in as 1 system message at the top, and return the body.

    :param body: the JSON body of the chat request
    :param __request__: the request, for its `Accept-Language` header
    """
    if not getattr(self.valves, "enabled", True):
      return body
    messages = body.get("messages") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(messages, list):
      return body
    kept = [
      message
      for message in messages
      if not (
        isinstance(message, dict) and str(message.get("content") or "").startswith(MARK)
      )
    ]
    block = {"role": "system", "content": self._block(__request__)}
    return {**body, "messages": [block, *kept]}

meta.description: Inject the date, the clock, the timezone, the place and the language at the top of the chat. No key.
